summary: A parametric deck card. One number cuts the same slice of rock again, and no colour on it was chosen.

origin: Sibling of BIFURCATA-011, LEVIATHAN-010 and PANGEA-012. Those three grind pigment; this one takes its colour from a published physical curve instead.
